nodes.label: D
nodes.title:
The power to expell the demon.
The outer correspondence is about son of man. The second correspondence is about blasphemy. The third correspondence is about domestic conflict and influential person. The forth correspondence is question answer about what is the power to expell demons. The former half includes erroneous insists, and the latter half includes objections against former insists. This structure emphasizes the power of Spirit of God
